display.title: Magic Stat 1.0.2 is here
display.subtitle: A smoother, faster Magic Stat — now available for you.
display.message: We've been hard at work polishing the experience: the app starts faster, large analyses run more smoothly and the SEM Builder now ships with complete ready-to-run example models. This update is included in your license — free of charge.
highlights: Faster startup and smoother performance on large datasets
SEM Builder now includes ready-to-run examples: direct effects, mediation, moderation and the full 12-construct model
General polish for a more fluid experience across the app
